component.name: NayutaCast
component.summary: Low-latency screen mirroring and Universal Smart TV casting

description.p: NayutaCast is a 100% native Rust desktop casting application and low-latency screen mirroring toolkit designed for standard Wi-Fi and LAN networks.

ul.li: Universal Smart TV support: Google Cast (Android TV / Chromecast), DLNA/UPnP, Apple AirPlay, Roku ECP, and browser /watch mode
Hardware-accelerated VAAPI (H.264) and software libx264 live multiplexing (fMP4, HLS, MPEG-TS)
Wayland wlr-screencopy, PipeWire screen/audio capture, and X11 MIT-SHM fallback
OS virtual display Mirror and Extend management on Wayland/Hyprland

screenshot.caption: Device scanner for Smart TVs and LAN receivers
Live screen casting and OS display Mirror/Extend controls
Video encoder, resolution, and audio stream settings

description.p: Initial v0.4.0 release with 100% native Rust desktop UI, Smart TV casting fixes, VAAPI/x264 live muxer timing improvements, and Flatpak support.
